title: Faunara: A Pokemon-Like MMO with Real Time Combat
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
GPT 6 is exceptional at helping me implement some of the more challenging mathematical implementations and that allowed me to create a ton of systems and tools for me to just work on. I started out by building my own "gaming konsole" and a game editor to go with it. AI helped a ton with creating my own personal game editor. I ALWAYS hated Unity...

  
Building using ThreeJS and AI has truly unlocked a level of coding I never thought I would achieve. Anywho, Faunara is a project that I have been planning for years. Every since I was disappointed by the constant failures of Pokemon and the eventual failure of Pokemon Arceus / Scarlet / Violet - my desire for a game similar to the WORLD of Pokemon felt like a distant dream.

  
Not anymore. Now I can build the exact world I always wanted to play in. That's all I have for now, I'm still working on the game but its fully playable and has at least 40 hours of content to play through. 

It works on mobile, Steam Deck, PC, tablet, XBOX, PS5, PS4, etc. 

If you're interested in playing, you can try it for free at [https://playkore.com/play/fuanara/](https://playkore.com/play/fuanara/)

Note: you can go to [playkore.com](http://playkore.com) and install the steam deck app + add to steam for easy access
